title: Trust & Safety of LLMs and LLMs in Trust & Safety

bias_targets.methodology: The paper conducts a systematic review of LLM trustworthiness and outlines Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for evaluating bias, including measuring performance disparities across demographic groups (group fairness), counterfactual fairness (assessing the impact of changing input attributes), and evaluating outputs for discrimination based on protected attributes.
